title: After a hook refusal, a session posts only the correction, never the whole reply again (ruling R10)
why: The owner restated ruling R10 (decision guard-remedy-not-to-owner, his feedback fb-1544-5), relayed by the consultant at 09:20 CST Nov 17: after a hook refusal, post only the correction, never resend the whole reply. Triage 9 resent whole replies after report-shape refusals several times this session before this was relayed.
source: Consultant message to triage 9, 09:20 CST Nov 17 (relayed, not read by triage 9 in the owner's own message). Searched steps at 09:21 CST: no like step found. Filed by triage 9.
note: Doing, consultant, branch stop-refusal-correction-only (consultant relay; no PR read by triage 9 yet). Mistake it answers: triage 9 resent a full reply after a Stop-hook refusal at about 04:00 and 09:10 CST Nov 17. Guard idea, the consultant's to size: the report guard accepts a correction-only reply after a refusal. Whether it can be read mechanically is unmeasured.
